x: Wright taking fourth place, and in the first of the 220 Yards races Bowers finished second to Wigley of the Triangle, but in the second race Wright won, beating Littler of the home club.
Wigley, the T.V.H. sprinter, with A.
We were minus Botwright and Broadbent in the sprints, and both the 100 and 220 Yard races were won by Wigley, the T.V.H. boy. Syd Jarlett ran well to win the 880 Yards, and he beat G.
